supporting_pages.title: Configure settings \_|\_ Mainframe Assessment Tool \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: You can configure Mainframe Assessment Tool to use a different model from the following available options: Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Preview ) Gemini 3 Flash ( Preview ) Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Gemini 2.5 Flash Gemini 2.5 Pro For models that support Thinking level configuration, Thinking level can be selected on the Thinking level drop-down.
By default, Mainframe Assessment Tool uses Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and 2.5 Flash, adaptively.
To clear the Gemini cache, click Clear model cache .

evidence_snippets: Supported AI models: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and Gemini 3 Flash Preview.
Ask Gemini The Ask Gemini chat pane lets you explore your assessment using natural language.
Mainframe Assessment Tool uses the Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview for domain image generation.

evidence_snippets: Gemini 3 Flash is only available through the global endpoint and might not be available in all regions.
Note: Business rules extraction uses Gemini 3 Flash ( Preview ).
Exporting business rules lets you use the rules as input with tools such as Gemini CLI for modernization and analysis, share them with stakeholders, or perform offline analysis.
